text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED: private-controlplane-unreachable — customer=AcmeCorp env=prod — severity=P1 — pd-incident=PD-4321
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-4321 triggered and routed to on-call. Escalation policy: private-vpc-prod.
alex: ack — looking
mira: on my way, grabbing pager info. alex can you paste last successful heartbeat timestamp from the agent?
alex: running `curl -s http://10.10.7.5:9100/health` on the control-plane-facing proxy — nothing returned. Last heartbeat in our logs ~ 2027-11-03T02:15:32Z. now 02:22Z.
raj: I see TCP connection drops to AcmeCorp's agent IP from our egress for the past 7 mins. Traceroute shows hop 4 timeout.
emma: customer-eng pinged AcmeCorp (internal contact: j.lopez) at +1; they said they didn’t change anything on their side.
sre-lead: quick scope — is this only for this customer control plane traffic or whole VPC peering?
alex: looks isolated to private agent IP block 10.10.7.0/24. No other customers affected on that hostpool.
netops-bot: BGP event detected on peering-12 between us and aws-us-east-2: route withdraw for 10.10.7.0/24 at 2027-11-03T02:18:40Z.
mira: netops, can you confirm whether peering flap is upstream or our side?
netops-bot: Preliminary: peer AS 64555 withdrew route. We are still advertising. Investigating with cloud provider.
raj: running remote agent status via control-plane logs: `agent_id=acme-prod-7` shows last heartbeat accepted, then retries and TCP RSTs.
alex: j.lopez (Acme) just replied: "we see nothing, our team hasn't changed firewall. we'll join a quick call if needed."
emma: scheduling a 10-min call with Acme now, invite sent.
mira: mitigation options: 1) Failover to hostpool in a different AZ 2) Request Acme to verify AWS route tables/security group 3) Temporary tunnel via fallback relay in us-east-1
sre-lead: priority is restore control plane reachability. Raj, can you spin up fallback relay and allocate a temporary NAT to peer with Acme? What's ETA?
raj: I can provision a relay instance and update routing in ~8-10 mins if we approve. Need approval for cross-account peering change.
alex: approve relay. Also let's enable higher log level on agent for 5 mins to capture TCP handshake. Command: `redwoodctl agent debug acme-prod-7 --duration 300s`
raj: relay spun up (relay-ephem-763), IP 52.12.34.98. Adding route via relay and updating routing table entries for control-plane flow.
netops-bot: Route to 10.10.7.0/24 via relay-ephem-763 injected at 2027-11-03T02:29:05Z.
alex: attempting to contact agent through relay: `curl -s http://52.12.34.98:9100/health` — OK, response: {"status":"ok","agent_id":"acme-prod-7","last_heartbeat":"2027-11-03T02:29:00Z"}
emma: confirmed with Acme on the call — they see our new connection from 52.12.34.98 and agent responded. They will open ticket with their network team to validate peering.
mira: customers affected: single customer AcmeCorp. Impact: control plane messages delayed ~7–15min, no data plane regressions reported.
sre-lead: mitigation in place (relay). Next steps: 1) Keep relay for 1 hour, monitor for reappearance of direct route 2) Work with cloud provider to resolve BGP withdraw 3) Coordinate post-incident RCA and customer communication.
raj: monitoring latency to agent via relay: avg RTT 42ms, no packet loss for 2 consecutive checks.
alex: uploaded debug logs snippet (truncated): ```
[02:15:32Z] INFO heartbeat sent
[02:18:39Z] WARN connection reset by peer
[02:18:40Z] ERROR TCP RST received
[02:29:00Z] INFO heartbeat acknowledged via relay
```
emma: notified Acme Customer Ops of workaround and relay details. They asked for ETA to full restoration; we advised we will update within 30 mins.
mira: handoff plan: I'm staying on for next 40 mins to monitor. After that alex takes bridge for 30m, then handoff to next oncall (raj) if still necessary.
sre-lead: filing incident ticket IR-2027-1103-Acme, will add notes and timeline. Assigning postmortem to mira + netops.
pagerduty: PD-4321 acknowledged by alex at 2027-11-03T02:23:11Z. Current status: acknowledged -> investigating.
emma: logging customer-facing blurb for CS: "We experienced a brief control plane connectivity issue affecting the AcmeCorp private deployment. A temporary relay was put in place to restore connectivity while we investigate a BGP route withdrawal. No data loss reported. We'll provide a follow-up within 30 minutes."
raj: I'll keep the relay running and run repeated traceroutes. If direct route returns and stabilizes for 3 checks, will remove relay and update routing.
mira: agreed. tagging engineers: @raj @alex @netops-bot.
alex: note for handoff — saved relay config in `infra/ephemeral-relays/AcmeCorp-20271103.yaml` and pinned agent debug logs to the incident thread.
customer-eng: thanks team — Acme confirmed service restored on their side. They'll keep monitoring and update us if anything else.
sre-lead: closing timeline: mitigation applied 02:29Z (relay up). Monitoring window started. If stable after 1h, we'll close incident and publish RCA draft.
alex: thanks all. :thumbsup:
mira: leaving bridge, will check back in 30m.
